subject: Kickoff: Summit Consulting — Partner Scout Program & First 45-day Enablement
messages:
From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@summitconsulting.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Summit Consulting Partnerships <partners@summitconsulting.com>
Date: Tue, 30 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Summit x Redwood — Partner Scout Program kickoff

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the quick intro last week. Summit Consulting is excited to move forward with Redwood as a strategic partner for our Partner Scout Program. We have a slate of three pilot customers that want joint workshops and a lightweight co-sell motion. Before our kickoff, can you share a high-level onboarding checklist and any scoping questionnaire we should ask the customers?

High-level asks from our side:
- Shared sandbox access for SI engineers (short-term)
- Train-the-trainer session for our delivery leads (1.5 hours)
- Security/compliance intake (SOC2 checklist + evidence path)
- Timeline for first joint workshop (target: mid-June)

We’ve attached a short internal note with the pilot customer names — happy to share PO timing after we align on scope.

Looking forward to a kickoff call. Are you available Thu 5/31 or Mon 6/4 for a 30-minute alignment?

Best,
Elena Torres
Head of Partnerships | Summit Consulting
attachments: summit_pilot_list.csv (csv)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@summitconsulting.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 May 2028 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Summit x Redwood — Partner Scout Program kickoff

Hi Elena — great to hear and excited to partner.

I’ve attached an onboarding matrix and a short scoping questionnaire (see attachments). Quick answers to your asks below and proposed next steps: 

- Sandbox access: we can provision a 30-day SI sandbox with preloaded demo models. We’ll need the engineers’ emails to invite.
- Train-the-trainer: we run a 90-minute session that covers runtime basics, deployment patterns, and troubleshooting. I attached our train-the-trainer agenda for reference.
- Security intake: we don’t attach full SOC2 reports in initial threads; instead we share a scoped evidence checklist and a process for secure handoff — attached.
- Timeline: mid-June looks good. We can do a pilot workshop the week of June 12 if we provision sandboxes this week.

Proposed immediate actions:
1) You share the engineer emails and any customer PII restrictions.
2) We provision sandbox and send invites (target: 48 hours).
3) Schedule train-the-trainer — available slots: 6/6 11:00-12:30 PT, 6/7 09:00-10:30 PT, 6/9 14:00-15:30 PT.

I’m looping in Marissa (partner enablement) and Sean (partner ops) to coordinate the workshop logistics and SOW alignment.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head of Partner Programs | Redwood Inference
attachments: summit_onboarding_matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet); si_scoping_questionnaire.pdf (pdf); redwood_train-the-trainer-agenda.pdf (pdf); security_evidence_instructions.docx (docx)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 31 May 2028 08:44:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Summit x Redwood — Partner Scout Program kickoff

Thanks Kim — quick logistics note from enablement: 

- For the train-the-trainer, we recommend two modules: (A) Core runtime & serving patterns (45 min), (B) Troubleshooting + demo orchestration (45 min). Add a 15-min Q&A at the end. I’ll own the slides and hands-on lab steps.
- We should capture a mutual action plan (MAP) during the kickoff with milestones: sandbox invites, proof-of-concept scope, workshop dates, SOW/PO target, and post-workshop adoption metrics (engaged customers, demo conversions).
- For the sandbox invites, please confirm whether Summit wants SSH access to a shared environment or just developer accounts in a managed sandbox. If they want SSH, we’ll need an exception review (security).

Suggested owner assignments:
- Sandbox provisioning: Sean (partner ops)
- Train-the-trainer content + lab: Marissa (enablement)
- Security intake + evidence handoff: Kimberly (partner programs)
- MAP & SOW: Kimberly + Summit legal

Elena — can you confirm SSH preference and share the three engineers’ emails? Also indicate whether any pilot customers are on EU data residency requirements.

-Marissa
Partner Enablement | Redwood Inference

Hi all — quick update and confirmations: 

1) SSH: we do NOT need SSH. Managed sandbox developer accounts are preferred.
2) Engineer emails: alvin.cho@summitconsulting.com, priya.najjar@summitconsulting.com, mark.davila@summitconsulting.com
3) EU data residency: one pilot (Acme Health) requires EU residency — we’ll flag that in the MAP.
4) Workshop slot: June 12, 13:00-15:00 BST (which I believe is 06:00-08:00 PT) — can Redwood cover a later PT-friendly slot? Alternatively, we can run two sessions for different regions.

We reviewed the attachments and the scoping questionnaire — looks good. I’ve routed the SOW conversation internally; Summit will aim to issue a PO by end of next week contingent on the MAP and security notes.
